name: car-rental-system
description: Car Rental System — customer web, operations dashboard, and shared backend (also serves the deferred mobile app).

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @carrental/api build && pnpm --filter @carrental/web build
scripts.verify:static: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm --filter @carrental/contracts check:drift
scripts.verify:e2e: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @carrental/web build && bash scripts/verify-e2e.sh
scripts.verify:quick: pnpm verify:static && pnpm verify:unit && pnpm verify:api
scripts.verify:all: pnpm verify:static && pnpm verify:i18n && pnpm verify:theme && pnpm verify:unit && pnpm verify:api && pnpm verify:migrate && pnpm verify:security && pnpm verify:seo && pnpm verify:e2e && pnpm verify:a11y
scripts.verify:security: pnpm --filter @carrental/api exec vitest run --config vitest.api.config.ts test/security.spec.ts
scripts.verify:theme: pnpm --filter @carrental/theme build && pnpm --filter @carrental/theme check:css && pnpm --filter @carrental/theme exec vitest run && bash scripts/check-theme-literals.sh
